issues.title: Low contrast metadata text
issues.description: Secondary captions beneath preview cards have insufficient contrast against the background.
issues.evidence: Labels such as 'material ultrathin' and 'svg-displacement' blend into the dark card surface.
issues.suggestion: Increase opacity or lighten token color for dark mode readability.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: baked-in specimen caption used hardcoded text-neutral-400/500, and the neutral scale inverts in dark theme (neutral-400 → rgb(85 82 76) on dark surfaces ≈2.3:1, near-illegible). Replaced with the semantic text-muted-foreground token in GlassRefraction.tsx (dark ≈5.2:1); also resolves the same caption flagged via pair-094/pair-106.

issues.title: Specimen order mismatch
issues.description: The specimen order conflicts with the subheader label sequence in the refraction showcase.
issues.evidence: Header lists 'thin · thick' while the cards below are arranged with THICK on the left and THIN on the right.
issues.suggestion: Align the header label order with the physical card layout.
issues.triageNote: Root cause is page composition in src/app/eval/pair-167/page.tsx (line 94 'thin · thick' Latin label vs the page's own RTL grid-cols-2 at line 97); the label and grid are not in the component and eval pages are off-limits to fix agents. Page-level remedy: reverse the label to 'thick · thin', isolate it with dir="ltr", or pin the specimen grid dir="ltr" so label order matches visual order.
